description: Averaging mixer summing three inputs to one output twice over, or all six inputs to a single mix

params.text: Up keeps two groups, the IN A jacks averaged to the first output and the IN B jacks to the second; down averages all six inputs and sends that to both outputs

inputs.text: A signal averaged with the other patched IN A jacks, or with all six inputs when the mode switch is down
A signal averaged with the other patched IN B jacks, or with all six inputs when the mode switch is down

outputs.text: The sum of the patched IN A jacks divided by how many of them are patched, or the average of all six inputs when the mode switch is down
The sum of the patched IN B jacks divided by how many of them are patched, or the average of all six inputs when the mode switch is down
